findings.title: Route sends traffic to a workload, not a Service
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop sends the requests of rule 1 to Deployment storefront, and a route sends traffic to Services, not to Deployments: the controller cannot resolve the reference (InvalidKind) and answers those requests with an error (HTTP 500); Service storefront selects Deployment storefront's pods

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-route-to-deployment -o jsonpath='{.spec.rules[*].backendRefs}'

evidence.what: Service storefront selects Deployment storefront's pods
evidence.command: kubectl get service storefront -n kd-gateway-route-to-deployment -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'

findings.fix: Send the rule to Service storefront, which selects Deployment storefront's pods: set the backendRef's name to storefront and remove kind (and group), which default to Service.
